title: The Priceless Maracas
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Priceless Maracas.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Hestu]] |location= West Necluda |prereq= |reward= [[Inventory]] Expansion{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 220|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Priceless Maracas||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Priceless Maracas}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|West Necluda}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== On the path between [[Kakariko Bridge]] and [[Kakariko Village]], [[Link]] can encounter [[Hestu]]. He expresses his shock that Link is able to see him,{{Cite|{{Big|Shalaka?!}} You! You can see me?!|Hestu|BotW}} revealing it has been 100 years since someone has done so.{{Cite|♪Shala-zah! Shala-kah!♪ It's been 100 years since anyone has been able to see me!|Hestu|BotW}} After introducing himself, Hestu explains that he needs Link's help.{{Cite|I'm Hestu, and I need your help!|Hestu|BotW}} A group of [[Blue Bokoblin]]s have stolen [[Hestu's Maracas]] and are hiding behind a grouping of rocks just up the path.{{Cite|Those monsters over there stole my beloved {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}}! I think they're still there on the other side of those rocks.|Hestu|BotW}} Without them, Hestu is unable to use his powers.{{Cite|I can't use my {{Color BotW|Blue|powers}} without them. {{Small|Shoko...}}|Hestu|BotW}} He asks Link to retrieve them for him,{{Cite|So please! PLEASE get my {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}} back from them!|Hestu|BotW}} which begins the [[Side Quest]]. Past the rocks, Link will find a [[Monster Stronghold]] comprised of three Blue Bokoblins. Once all of them have been defeated, the [[Treasure Chest]] containing Hestu's Maracas at the back of the stronghold will be unlocked. Hestu is shocked to see that Link has his maracas and will ask for them back.{{Cite|{{Big|SHALA-KALA! Those are...}} Those are my {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}}! Please giiiiiive them to meeeeeeeee!|Hestu|BotW}} Though he is happy to have them back at first,{{Cite|♪SHAAAAAA-LAAAAAH-KAAAAAAH!♪|Hestu|BotW}} Hestu realizes that they are missing the [[Korok Seed]]s inside of them.{{Cite|But wait! There's something wrong with my maracas! The {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}} inside are gone! How am I supposed to dance now? Shoko...|Hestu|BotW}} If Link brings him a Korok Seed, Hestu would be able to use his powers to expand his [[Inventory]].{{Cite|If I had just {{Color BotW|Red|one Korok seeds}}, I could sing, dance, and use my {{Color BotW|Blue|powers}} to help you. You see, I have the power of {{Color BotW|Blue|inventory}} expansion! So let me know if you find some {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}}!|Hestu|BotW}} When Link next speaks to Hestu, he reveals that the Korok Seeds must have been stolen by the other [[Korok]]s as a prank.{{Cite|The children of the forest must have taken the {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}} from my beloved maracas. I never thought I'd be the target of one of their pranks. Shoko...|Hestu|BotW}} However, when he realizes that Link has at least one Korok Seed,{{Cite|Do you have a {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seed}}?! You do! You got a {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seed}} from one of the forest children!|Hestu|BotW}} he will ask for in exchange for expanding his Inventory.{{Cite|If you'll give me just {{Color BotW|Red|one Korok seed}}, I'll make you {{Color BotW|Blue|inventory}} bigger in return!|Hestu|BotW}} If Link agrees to hand a Korok Seed over, Hestu asks him which stash he would like to expand.{{Cite|[Yes, please!] SHALAKA! So which {{Color BotW|Blue|stash}} do you want more slots in?|Hestu|BotW}} Hestu will expand Link's stashes twice, after which he realizes how late it has become.{{Cite|Oh! Look at the time!|Hestu|BotW}} He has to leave before the [[Great Deku Tree]] gets mad at him for being out so long.{{Cite|I need to get back before {{Color BotW|Red|Grandpa}} yells at me. {{Small|Shoko...}}|Hestu|BotW}} If Link ever has any more Korok Seeds, Hestu encourages him to come to [[Korok Forest]] to give them to him.{{Cite|Sorry, I have to go. But I still need Korok seeds, so bring some to {{Color BotW|Red|Korok Forest}} if you find any!|Hestu|BotW}} With this, the Side Quest will be complete. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | The forest spirit Hestu has asked you to retrieve the maracas that were stolen from him by a group of monsters camping nearby.

Hestu claims that he is unable to use his vast powers without the maracas. |- | 2 | You've safely returned the maracas, but now Hestu is asking you to find the Korok seeds that were once inside.

The more Korok seeds you find, the more power will return to Hestu's maracas, which he can use to allow you to carry more things. |- | Complete | You returned Hestu's maracas after getting them back from the monsters.

When you returned the Korok seeds that you found, he allowed you to carry more things. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hestu * West Necluda }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
